verdict.rationale: The project documents two of the story's distribution paths: installation through a Claude Code plugin marketplace (`/plugin marketplace add` / `/plugin install`) and a project-local install by copying the skill folders into the repo's `.claude/skills/`, where they can be committed for the whole team. Missing for 10: any team-oriented guidance (e.g., pinning versions or auto-enabling the plugin for every teammate), and independent or hands-on corroboration that team-wide distribution works as described.
